questions.q: What welding work have you done? Tell us which type, like arc, MIG, TIG or gas welding, and what jobs you welded?
questions.looks_for: Specific processes and materials (mild steel, stainless, pipes, structures), positions they can weld, where and how long, any certificate. Honest about what they cannot do yet.
questions.te: మీరు ఏ welding పని చేశారు? Arc, MIG, TIG లేదా gas welding లో ఏది, ఏ jobs weld చేశారు చెప్పండి?
questions.hi: आपने कौन सा welding काम किया है? Arc, MIG, TIG या gas welding में से कौन सा, और कौन से jobs weld किए, बताइए?

questions.q: Tell us about one welding job you are proud of. What did you make or repair, and why was it good?
questions.looks_for: A concrete job: what it was, the process used, how they prepared and checked it, and how quality was confirmed (no leaks, passed inspection, strong joint).
questions.te: మీకు గర్వంగా అనిపించిన ఒక welding పని గురించి చెప్పండి. మీరు ఏం తయారు చేశారు లేదా repair చేశారు, అది ఎందుకు బాగుంది?
questions.hi: किसी एक welding काम के बारे में बताइए जिस पर आपको गर्व है। आपने क्या बनाया या repair किया, और वह अच्छा क्यों था?

questions.q: Before you start welding, what safety things do you check and wear?
questions.looks_for: Helmet or shield with the right filter, gloves, apron, safety shoes, full sleeves; checks cables, earth clamp and holder; removes flammable items; good ventilation; fire extinguisher nearby; screens to protect others' eyes.
questions.te: Welding మొదలుపెట్టే ముందు మీరు ఏ safety విషయాలు check చేస్తారు, ఏమేమి వేసుకుంటారు?
questions.hi: Welding शुरू करने से पहले आप कौन सी safety चीज़ें check करते हैं और क्या पहनते हैं?

questions.q: How do you choose the electrode and the current for welding a mild steel plate? What happens if the current is too high or too low?
questions.looks_for: Chooses electrode type and size by plate thickness (for example 3.15 mm rod for medium plate), sets current to suit the rod, keeps rods dry. Too high: spatter, undercut, burn-through. Too low: rod sticks, poor fusion, slag inside.
questions.te: Mild steel plate weld చేయడానికి electrode, current ఎలా select చేస్తారు? Current ఎక్కువైతే లేదా తక్కువైతే ఏం జరుగుతుంది?
questions.hi: Mild steel plate weld करने के लिए electrode और current कैसे चुनते हैं? Current बहुत ज़्यादा या बहुत कम हो तो क्या होता है?

questions.q: After welding, how do you check if the weld is good? What defects do you look for?
questions.looks_for: Removes slag and cleans, checks visually for cracks, porosity, undercut, poor fusion, uneven bead and spatter; checks size against the drawing; reports or repairs defects; mentions tests like dye penetrant if they know.
questions.te: Welding అయిపోయాక weld బాగుందో లేదో ఎలా check చేస్తారు? ఏ defects కోసం చూస్తారు?
questions.hi: Welding के बाद आप कैसे check करते हैं कि weld अच्छा है? आप कौन से defects देखते हैं?

questions.q: You are asked to weld near some oil drums and gas cylinders, and there is no fire extinguisher nearby. What will you do?
questions.looks_for: Does not start; asks for the drums and cylinders to be moved or covered, gets a fire extinguisher and a fire watcher, follows hot-work permit; informs the supervisor. Safety before deadline.
questions.te: కొన్ని oil drums, gas cylinders దగ్గర weld చేయమని చెప్పారు, దగ్గరలో fire extinguisher లేదు. మీరు ఏం చేస్తారు?
questions.hi: आपको कुछ oil drums और gas cylinders के पास weld करने को कहा गया है, और पास में fire extinguisher नहीं है। आप क्या करेंगे?

questions.q: Why do you want to work as a welder? When can you join, and what salary do you expect? Can you say your notice period and salary clearly?
questions.looks_for: A genuine reason, a clear joining date or notice period, and a clear salary figure. May mention site work or travel comfort honestly.
questions.te: మీరు welder గా ఎందుకు పని చేయాలనుకుంటున్నారు? ఎప్పుడు join అవ్వగలరు, ఎంత salary ఆశిస్తున్నారు? మీ notice period, salary స్పష్టంగా చెప్పండి?
questions.hi: आप welder का काम क्यों करना चाहते हैं? आप कब join कर सकते हैं, और कितनी salary चाहते हैं? अपना notice period और salary साफ़ बताइए?
